premise.goal: Use a mathematically valid component interval around cooperative PV and replay the scalar chain only when the interval crosses the retained BF16 rounding bin.
premise.fixture: deterministic wrapped full-ring SWA512 fixture, 72 query heads x D128
premise.favorable_scope: PV-only; QK, exponential, normalization, and decomposition error are omitted.

decision.reason: The independently valid full-ring interval sends 84.58% of output components and every query head to scalar replay before adding omitted error sources. The measured replay topology is already slower than retained exact attention at complete replay.
decision.reopen_condition: A materially tighter certified mechanism such as hardware-directed bounds or a separately cheap error-free transform.
